units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:1">Zeb. V, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ החיצון</he>, v. <cite ref="H00863"><he>חִיצוֹן</he></cite> <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 3:1">Tam. III, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>מ׳ הפנימי</he> the inner altar (in the interior of the Temple).—
<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 5:5">Gitt. V, 5</cite> <he>מפני תקון המ׳</he> in order to prevent neglect of the altar.
<cite ref="Gittin 55b:1">Ib. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא יאמרו מ׳ אוכל וכ׳</he> lest people say, the altar receives stolen goods.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80:1">Gen. R. s. 80</cite> <he>כמ׳ כן כהניו</he> as the altar, so are its priests; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:6:13">Y. Snh. II, end, 20ᵈ</cite>; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 53b:18">Ab. Zar. 53ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:2">Tosef. ib. V</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 6:8">VI</cite>), 8, a. e. (of an idolatrous altar), v. <cite ref="B00630"><he>בִּימוּס</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>מִזְבְּחוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>הרי אמנו בנתה שבעה מ׳ וכ׳</he> behold, our mother built seven altars and offered seven children on one day (as martyrs of their faith).
